hero.heading: The APT Foundation
hero.html:
For nature. For humanity. For tomorrow.

The APT Foundation is the APT Travel Group’s not-for-profit charitable fund. Joining the brands APT, Travelmarvel, Botanica, Captain’s Choice, Antarctica Flights and TravelGlo, the APT Foundation’s mission is to make a positive and enduring impact on nature and the communities we touch. This is achieved through immediate and long-term influence in various environmental and humanitarian causes.

contentBlocks.html: The APT Foundation is the philanthropic arm of the APT Travel Group of companies

Who do we support?

The APT Foundation has partnered with the following charities. You can choose who you want to support while being assured every dollar you donate will go directly to funding vital programs and services. Click on any of the logos below to find out more about a cause that interests you.

How it works

Donate to select grassroots causes, or give directly to the APT Foundation, who will distribute the funds where they need to go. These causes have been carefully researched and selected by local experts based on the impact they make and the passion of their staff. With your financial support, local not-for-profit organisations can continue serving the world and their communities. The best part? Donations through the APT Foundation are tax deductible, and all donations will be matched. Dollar for dollar.

contentBlocks.html:
Responsible Travel

At the APT Foundation, we aspire to reduce our global footprint when travelling. By following a set of guidelines for conscientious travel, we hope to continue the increasing trend of travelling the world without bringing harm to the culture, environment, economies or locals of the places we visit.
